```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given a new Doctor with name "John Doe", age 30, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 5, speciality "Cardiology"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the Doctor is added successfully with a unique ID
    And the Doctor's details are stored in the system

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and details "John Doe", 30, "Male", "MBBS", 5, "Cardiology"
    When I view the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Doctor's details with new name "Jane Doe", age 31, sex "Female", qualification "MBBS", experience 6, speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the Doctor's details are updated successfully
    And the Doctor's speciality is not updated

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and details "John Doe", 30, "Male", "MBBS", 5, "Cardiology"
    When I delete the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are deleted successfully
    And no new Patient Consultation Request is pending

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given a new Chemist with name "Chemist 1", pincode 123456, address "Address 1"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then the Chemist is added successfully with a unique ID
    And the Chemist's details are stored in the system

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID "C001" and details "Chemist 1", pincode 123456, address "Address 1"
    When I view the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Chemist's details with new name "Chemist 2", pincode 123456, address "Address 2"
    Then the Chemist's details are updated successfully
    And the Chemist's pincode is not updated

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID "C001" and details "Chemist 1", pincode 123456, address "Address 1"
    When I delete the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are deleted successfully
    And no new Prescription is pending

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Doctors with unique IDs
    Given a new Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", speciality "<speciality>"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the Doctor is added successfully with a unique ID
    Examples:
      | name | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | John | 30  | Male | MBBS          | 5          | Cardiology |
      | Jane | 31  | Female| MBBS          | 6          | Cardiology |
      | Bob  | 32  | Male | MBBS          | 7          | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Chemists/Labs with unique IDs
    Given a new Chemist with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", address "<address>"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then the Chemist is added successfully with a unique ID
    Examples:
      | name | pincode | address |
      | Chemist 1 | 123456 | Address 1 |
      | Chemist 2 | 123456 | Address 2 |
      | Chemist 3 | 123456 | Address 3 |

  Scenario: Delete Doctor/Lab with pending requests
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and details "John Doe", 30, "Male", "MBBS", 5, "Cardiology"
    And a new Patient Consultation Request is pending
    When I delete the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are not deleted due to pending requests

  Scenario: Update speciality/pincode
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and details "John Doe", 30, "Male", "MBBS", 5, "Cardiology"
    When I update the Doctor's speciality to "Neurology"
    Then the Doctor's speciality is not updated
    When I update the Chemist's pincode to 123457
    Then the Chemist's pincode is not updated

  Scenario: Verify actual field values after update
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and details "John Doe", 30, "Male", "MBBS", 5, "Cardiology"
    When I update the Doctor's details with new name "Jane Doe", age 31, sex "Female", qualification "MBBS", experience 6, speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the Doctor's actual details are updated correctly
```
